verses.author: model_A
verses.text: The last snow melts from the roof tiles one drop at a time.

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
a gutter's slow pulse—
someone inside is counting
what winter still owes

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
the ledger left open
where light finally reaches

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
a moth returns
to the same blank page
looking for its old address

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
ink dries into rivers
where no one has traveled yet

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
the counting stops
where the gutter meets the ground—
someone else's turn to owe

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
rain fills the ledger's blank
with its own small currency

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
a coin left on the sill
learns the patience of light

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
the sill forgets the coin
before the coin forgets the hand
that set it down like a question

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
no answer waits that long
the hand has already opened
onto something else

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
the window keeps its own count
of hands that opened, closed, moved on
not one of them a question anymore

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
dust settles where the coin was
this is not forgetting
it's what light does with what's left behind

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
a moth finds the same sill
mistakes the dust for moonlight
keeps its faith anyway

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
I sweep the sill each morning
call it care, call it habit
the moth doesn't ask which

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
the broom leans by the door now
someone else's hand will find it
the sill keeps its own hours

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
I never learned the moth's name
still I miss its small collisions
against a light I didn't leave on
